title: Valid Palindrome With At Most K Deletions
description: Given a lowercase string `s` and an integer `k`, return `true` if `s` can be turned into a palindrome by removing at most `k` characters from `s`, and `false` otherwise.
constraints: s consists of lowercase English letters.
hints: Deleting at most k characters to leave a palindrome is equivalent to finding a palindromic subsequence of length at least n - k.
Compute the longest palindromic subsequence length in O(n^2) time and O(n) space, and check whether n - lps <= k.

examples.explanation: Removing 'b' and 'e' leaves "acdca", a palindrome using 2 deletions.
Removing the 'b' at index 1 leaves "abababa", a palindrome using 1 deletion.
"abcdef" requires 5 deletions to become a 1-character palindrome, so k = 2 is false.
